class.name: Game
class.brief_description: Code-first game actions and services owned by a live scene scope.

method.name: configure
method.description: Create a solo-ready draft for a fixed world and player scene.

method.name: campaign
method.description: Create a coordinated draft. Register game-owned state and permission rules before starting.

method.name: current
method.description: Return the explicitly selected or sole live game, or null when ambiguous.

method.name: for_node
method.description: Resolve the nearest live game owning this scene branch.

method.name: set_default
method.description: Select a live code-first game for global access, or pass null to clear it.

method.name: boot_result
method.description: Return the original boot outcome. An action additionally requires a live attachment.

method.name: play
method.description: Await the GameResult after solo startup makes the world playable.

method.name: host
method.description: Await a playable host and online publication when configured. The default bind is *. An optional public address advertises a direct route.

method.name: join
method.description: Await a verified, playable direct join using the configured port.

method.name: serve
method.description: Await a playerless world with admission open. Bind defaults to *. The optional advertised address defaults to empty.

method.name: find_and_join
method.description: Search the configured online game and await one verified playable join. Empty search, admission failure, and cancellation have distinct outcomes.

method.name: join_listing
method.description: Await the result of joining the exact selected listing.

method.name: open_lobby
method.description: Open a coordinated ENet lobby for identity binding. Bind defaults to *.

method.name: join_lobby
method.description: Begin joining a coordinated ENet lobby. Observe phase changes for admission and world readiness.

method.name: bind_player
method.description: Bind an identity verified by the game to an admitted peer in the authority lobby.

method.name: start_match
method.description: Await a coordinated world start after the authority binds its players. The default is the configured starting world.

method.name: invite_friends
method.description: Request Steam’s invite picker for the current owned lobby. Success acknowledges the request.

method.name: accept_invite
method.description: Await the result of accepting the exact pending offer. A replaced offer rejects and leaves its replacement pending.

method.name: pending_invite
method.description: Return the pending offer or null, including eligible launch-time offers.

method.name: dismiss_invite
method.description: Dismiss the exact pending offer without joining.

method.name: leave
method.description: Await retirement of the pending start or active session. An idle game succeeds immediately.

method.name: perform
method.description: Await the authority result for a coordinated command. The default payload is an empty dictionary.

method.name: register_command
method.description: Register a game-owned command before coordinated play. The authority runs its handler. Possession is optional by default.

method.name: transactions
method.description: Return the authority coordinator for game-owned store setup, or null when unavailable.

method.name: save_slot
method.description: Select a checkpoint slot in the configured coordinated game.

method.name: scenes
method.description: Return world actions tied to this attachment.

method.name: inventory
method.description: Return the configured inventory service, or null when disabled.

method.name: codecs
method.description: Return the codec registry for this game attachment. The same registry survives session leave and restarts. An unsuccessful or retired game returns null. When the game owner leaves the tree, retained references to the registry reject further work with [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE].

method.name: steam
method.description: Return the Steamworks facade for this exact game, including an unavailable facade when Steam is absent.

method.name: get_phase
method.description: Return the current Phase. Retired attachments report IDLE.

method.name: get_port
method.description: Return the configured UDP port, or zero when unavailable.

method.name: network_diagnostics
method.description: Sample local connection and movement state for a debugger. Returns a detached snapshot without changing the session. A detached game reports [constant GameNetworkDiagnostics.IDLE]. Sample again for fresh values.

method.name: get_world
method.description: Return the mounted world until travel or teardown.

method.name: is_player_controlled
method.description: Returns true when this fixed-world game was configured with authority-driven player movement.

method.name: get_local_player
method.description: Return the fixed-world local actor or null.

method.name: get_player
method.description: Return the fixed-world actor for the specified session peer or null.

signal.name: phase_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the runtime publishes the new phase.

signal.name: peer_joined
signal.description: Emitted when a peer is admitted.

signal.name: world_ready
signal.description: Emitted when the runtime publishes a playable world.

signal.name: invite_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the pending offer changes. Null clears the offer.

constants.constant: A post-commit synchronization failure needs recovery.
